name: Turčianske Teplice (Slovakia)
description: Nine equal horizontal stripes of white, blue, yellow, white, blue, yellow, white, blue and yellow, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature T-10/1991.
